Lin et al. define the underlying COT information set by fixing \(P_{Y(0),Z}\) and \(P_{Y(1),Z}\) with the same \(Z\)-marginal, but their main analysis additionally assumes complete randomization, compact convex support, densities, and smooth cost; Gaussian laws violate compact support.
